how_to_apply: Register online through the link on SBI's official website, https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
Scan your latest photograph and signature in the specified format before starting the application - the online application will not register without these uploads.

Fill in the application form carefully. You may save partially completed information; a provisional registration number and password will be generated - editing the saved application is allowed up to three times.

Upload all required documents: Resume, ID proof, Age proof, Caste Certificate (if applicable), PwBD Certificate (if applicable), Educational Qualification certificates, other qualifications/certifications, proof of experience, Biodata, and CTC Form.
Once the application is completely filled, submit it and proceed to online fee payment (if applicable) via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form bearing the submission date will be generated - print and retain this for your records.

important_instructions: The Bank reserves the right to change the notified vacancies, including reserved vacancies, without assigning any reason. The Bank reserves the right to cancel or modify the engagement process, entirely or partially, at any stage, without assigning any reason, and will not refund the fee or pay compensation in such an event. Candidates furnishing false information or suppressing facts will be disqualified and liable for debarment and legal/criminal action. Candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government offices, Public Sector Undertakings (including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions) must submit a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview, failing which their candidature will not be considered and travelling expenses (if otherwise admissible) will not be paid. Selected candidates must produce a proper discharge certificate from their current employer at the time of taking up the engagement. The Bank reserves the right to post/transfer engaged officers to any office of SBI in India, or depute them to any associate/subsidiary or other organization, depending on service requirements. Requests for a specific posting location will not be entertained. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute website load issues; SBI is not responsible for failure to submit an application due to such reasons. All updates, revisions, corrigenda, results, and shortlisting/selection lists will be hosted only on the Bank's website - no separate intimation will be issued. Candidates against whom there are adverse reports regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply; if such reports are received after selection, the candidature/engagement will be rejected forthwith. Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria (qualification and experience) does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Combined Grand Total: 7 posts across both notifications. PwBD reservation is horizontal and included within the respective parent category (UR/SC) - it is not an additional vacancy over the stated total. Reserved-category candidates (including PwBD) for whom no reservation is indicated are free to apply against Unreserved (UR) vacancies, provided they meet the UR eligibility criteria. The number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary as per the Bank's actual requirement.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Preference for Dean and Faculty posts is given to candidates with an MBA/Ph.D./M.Phil. in Banking & Finance and/or teaching experience in Executive Education, and to those with proven experience in Corporate Leadership Roles. For Marketing Executive, preference is given to candidates with experience in branding, international partnerships, programme portfolio generation, and revenue generation. Note: Training/teaching experience will NOT be counted for eligibility for the IT Risk posts. Candidates cannot apply for both IT Risk posts (Deputy VP and AVP) - only the last valid application will be retained if a candidate applies to both, and the fee paid for the other registration will be forfeited. For all posts, the prescribed qualification is a minimum requirement - the candidate must possess the required post-basic qualification and relevant full-time experience as on the specified dates. The relevant experience certificate from the employer must specifically state that the candidate had experience in the required field. Where the degree/diploma/PG certificate does not specify the field of specialization, the candidate must produce a certificate from the concerned university/college specifically mentioning the specialization.

rows.basic_educational_qualification: MBA / Executive MBA / PGDM / PGDBA or equivalent in any discipline (min. 55% marks), OR Ph.D./M.Phil. from an Indian university or Indian/International 'B' school
rows.post_qualification_experience: Total 15 years' post-qualification experience, including minimum 3 years as Dean/Deputy Dean/Principal/Director/Deputy Director/Joint Director/Head/Centre Head/Chief Learning Officer/Senior VP/VP or equivalent in a Bank's Training Institute/University/Business School/Corporate Learning Academy/Public Sector Training Institution/Other Educational Institution

rows.basic_educational_qualification: Postgraduate in any discipline (min. 55% marks); successful completion of Ph.D./M.Phil. is an additional qualification
rows.post_qualification_experience: Minimum 6 years' teaching experience as Faculty/Professor/Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Corporate Trainer or equivalent in a Bank's Training Institute/University/Business School/Corporate Learning Academy/Public Sector Training Institution/Other Educational Institution

rows.basic_educational_qualification: MBA or equivalent in Marketing (min. 55% marks)
rows.post_qualification_experience: Minimum 5 years' experience in Marketing, of which minimum 3 years in marketing of Executive Education/Management Institutes/Universities/Training Organizations/EdTech Organizations

rows.basic_educational_qualification: BE/BTech (Computer Science/Electronics & Communications/IT/Cybersecurity), min. 50% marks, OR MCA/MSc (Computer Science)/MSc (IT), min. 50%, OR MTech (Computer Science/Cyber Security/Information Security), min. 50%
rows.preferred_certifications: Any one of CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or CISA (valid, dated on or before last date of registration)
rows.post_qualification_experience: Minimum 12 years in the IT Domain, of which minimum 6 years in IT risk management or information security is preferable
Minimum 9 years in the IT Domain, of which minimum 5 years in IT risk management or information security is preferable

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting, followed by Interview cum Demo Session. Interview/Demo Session carries 100 marks; the qualifying marks are decided by the Bank. Shortlisting, followed by Interview. Shortlisting: A shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank decides the shortlisting parameters; merely fulfilling minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The Bank's decision is final, with no correspondence entertained. CTC Negotiation: Conducted with candidates in order of merit, one by one. If a selected candidate does not agree to the negotiated CTC, they are treated as a Voluntary Exit, and the next candidate in the merit list is called for negotiation. Final Selection: Top-most candidates in the merit list with whom CTC negotiation is successful are finally selected. Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents; candidature is subject to verification of all details/documents against originals at the time of interview. If a candidate called for interview/CTC negotiation is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (age, educational qualification, experience, etc.), they will not be allowed to appear for interview, and no travelling expenses will be reimbursed.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Contract Terms
content_sections.text: Contract Period: 3 years, extendable up to a maximum of 2 further years at the Bank's discretion (total engagement not to exceed 5 years). Notice Period: The contract can be terminated without assigning any reason, by giving 3 months' notice from either side, or by payment/surrender of 3 months' compensation in lieu thereof. Leave (Advt No. 20 posts): Officers Engaged on Contract (OECs) are entitled to 30 days' leave during the financial year, granted for genuine and appropriate reasons.

faq.question: Q1. What is SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It refers to two advertisements (CRPD/SCO/2026-27/20 and CRPD/SCO/2026-27/22) released by State Bank of India for engaging Specialist Cadre Officers on contract basis - Dean, Faculty and Marketing Executive at SBIL Kolkata, and Deputy Vice President/Assistant Vice President (IT Risk).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 7 total vacancies: 3 under Advt No. 20 (1 Dean, 1 Faculty, 1 Marketing Executive) and 4 under Advt No. 22 (2 Deputy VP-IT Risk, 2 AVP-IT Risk).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and fee payment is 06.10.2026, for both notifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post: 40–55 years (Dean), 35–55 years (Faculty), 28–40 years (Marketing Executive), 36–45 years (Deputy VP-IT Risk), and 32–42 years (AVP-IT Risk), all as on 31.08.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹750 for General/EWS/OBC candidates; SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for SBI SCO IT Risk posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BE/BTech in Computer Science/Electronics & Communications/IT/Cybersecurity, or MCA/MSc (Computer Science/IT), or MTech in Computer Science/Cyber Security/Information Security (minimum 50% marks), along with 12 years' (Deputy VP) or 9 years' (AVP) experience in the IT domain.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Selection involves Shortlisting followed by Interview (with a Demo Session for Dean and Faculty posts specifically), and then CTC Negotiation with candidates in order of merit.

faq.question: Q8. What is the CTC offered for SBI SCO posts?
faq.answer: CTC ranges from ₹50 lakhs (AVP-IT Risk) to up to ₹98 lakhs (Dean, SBIL Kolkata) per annum, negotiable based on experience and current emoluments, bifurcated into 80% fixed and 20% variable pay.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must register on https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings, fill the application form, upload required documents, pay the fee (if applicable), and submit before 06.10.2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate apply for both IT Risk posts under Advt No. 22?
faq.answer: No. A candidate cannot apply for both the Deputy Vice President (IT Risk) and Assistant Vice President (IT Risk) posts - only the last valid application will be retained, and the fee paid for the other registration will be forfeited.
